from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single company's financial report."""
    stock_short_name: str | None = Field(description="The stock short name (股票简称) reported in the document header")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code reported in the document header")
    company_full_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The financial reporting period mentioned in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_reports: list[CompanyFinancialReport]
